phase: research8 volatility term-structure trades on the daily panel (SPY + 10 most liquid names)
written_before_any_result: 2026-10-03, before any term-structure result from research8-daily-2026-10
contracts: At each session and name: front = listed expiry 21-45 calendar days out nearest 30; back = listed expiry 50-100 days out nearest 75; common strike = nearest spot with all four legs quoted; every leg bid > 0, mid >= 0.05, OI >= 10, (ask - bid)/mid <= 0.25; single names skipped if a dividend ex-date falls before the back expiry
signal: slope = back ATM IV / front ATM IV (each the mean of call and put IV from mids); percentile of today's slope among the name's previous 252 sessions with a candidate (needs >= 60)

trades.long_calendar: slope percentile <= 20% (front rich vs back): sell 1 front straddle, buy 1 back straddle
trades.short_calendar: slope percentile >= 80% (front cheap vs back): buy 1 front straddle, sell 1 back straddle

exits: time 5 sessions; time 10 sessions; revert = slope percentile (vs the same trailing history) crosses 50% or 10 sessions; event guard: close the session before a release; quotes missing -> next quoted session
hedge: hedged (daily delta hedge of all four legs at stock closes with entry IVs, 2 bp) or unhedged
rules: direction {2} x exit {time5, time10, revert} x hedge {2} = 12
returns: P&L per share / (front mid + back mid) at entry; execution at mid (primary), 25% of half-spreads, full bid/ask; fees $0.65 per contract per side on four legs reported separately; attribution of gross mid P&L into the front and back legs, hedge, spreads, fees
samples: dev: entries 2016-2021 with exits by 2021-12-31; test: entries from 2022-01-03
freeze_rule: Eligible on dev at 25%: >= 150 trades, weekly t >= 3.0, Sharpe > 0.8, positive in 2016-2018 and 2019-2021; freeze at most 2 (one per direction)
test_gates: as protocol_converge.json (25%: t >= 2, Sharpe >= 1, positive at full spread, positive in >= 3 of 2022-2025)
